title: Cellar, Meet Sword
brief: Rats are eating the winter grain. Clear the cellar without setting fire to the inn. A fine first assignment for a fighter.
report: The grain is safe. Bram counted eleven rats and one very offended cellar cat. The client signed the reward envelope.

title: Medicine Before Sundown
brief: Carry fever medicine across the marsh. A healer knows how to keep it dry; a ranger knows which stepping stones are real.
report: The medicine arrived intact. Ada sends a thank-you letter, a clean bandage, and strict instructions to get some sleep.

title: The Missing Beekeeper
brief: Find a beekeeper who followed his swarm into the woods. Tracks disappear at the stream. A ranger is strongly recommended.
report: The beekeeper was found sheltering in a hollow oak. Fresh wolf tracks explain the delay. Heatherwood is less safe than the client believed.

title: Something in the Well
brief: Noises below the mill, missing chickens above it. The villagers suspect slimes. Send support: nobody has actually looked down the well.
report: Goblins, not slimes. A tunnel beneath the mill explains the stolen chickens. Your report corrects the village threat register.

title: The Lantern Road Trial
brief: BRONZE ASSESSMENT. Escort the examiner through Lantern Road and recover the lost signal lamp. One candidate, unaided. Requires 60 XP and three successful contracts. Rest before dispatch.
report: The lamp burns again. The candidate held the crossing and brought everyone home. Vale's sealed recommendation authorizes Bronze certification. The final signature belongs to you.

title: A Bridge Worth Keeping
brief: Your first Bronze commission: protect a repair crew on the north bridge. At least one Bronze adventurer must lead. A balanced party will make the road safe again.
report: The bridge is open. The repair crew raised a small guild banner on the parapet. Your branch is now trusted with the road beyond the village.
